verdict.rationale: Fedora Workstation ships general-purpose tooling (dnf package installs, container tools, Boxes VMs) that a developer could use to build a dev environment, but there is no evidence of preconfigured, framework/language-specific environment templates (e.g., devcontainers, language-specific toolchains bundled out of the box). Missing for 10: dedicated preconfigured environment templates for popular frameworks/languages, first-party tooling like devcontainer support, and any independent corroboration of ease-of-setup for specific stacks.
